# Zeron UI

> Zeron is a React component library and source-code Registry built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI primitives, and motion. It provides semantic design tokens, accessible controls, application layouts, and business blocks for light and dark themes.

This index covers the current documentation catalog. Follow the relevant links for usage, examples, and API details. English documentation uses /en/docs; remove /en for Chinese documentation. Verify exact exports, props, callback signatures, and defaults against the installed component source when versions differ.

## Start here

- [Introduction and installation](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs): Set up Zeron, install components, and discover agent skills.
- [Component catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components): Foundations, layouts, controls, and component documentation.
- [Block catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/blocks): Reusable business regions and compositions.
- [Page catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/pages): Complete page templates and workflows.
- [Registry index](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/r/registry.json): Machine-readable installation names, dependencies, and Registry items.
- [Agent skill installation](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/skills/install.md): Install the page-building and UI-migration skills with their references.

Use `npx zeron-ui init` when the project has no components.json. Discover installable names with `npx zeron-ui list`, preview changes with `npx zeron-ui add <item> --dry-run`, then install with `npx zeron-ui add <item>`. Let the CLI resolve dependencies and theme integration. Current integration targets React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Next.js App Router or Vite React; check each block for additional framework requirements.

Consumer imports follow the aliases in components.json, commonly `@/components/ui/button`. Workspace examples using `@zeron/ui/...` do not establish consumer import paths or npm package availability. Install `surfaces` through the Registry for the token foundation; do not assume the workspace package `@zeron/tokens` is published.

## Design tokens and styling

Use semantic tokens by purpose. Let the theme supply light/dark values, and use component variants and sizes before overriding styles. These are common CSS variables and Tailwind utilities; the linked foundations document the full token set and usage rules.

- Text and icons: `--fg-default`, `--fg-muted`, `--fg-subtle`; use `text-fg-default`, `text-fg-muted`, and `text-fg-subtle`.
- Surfaces: `--surface-base`, `--surface-raised`, `--surface-floating`, `--surface-overlay`, `--surface-top`; use the matching `bg-surface-*` utility and follow the relative nesting rules.
- Actions: `--primary-action`, `--neutral-action`, `--destructive-action`, and `--secondary-action`; pair fills with their documented foregrounds, such as `--fg-on-primary-action`. Prefer Button variants for actions.
- Boundaries and focus: `--border`, `--border-subtle`, `--input`, and `--focus-ring`; preserve built-in control borders and visible focus. Use `border-hairline` for intentional 0.5px dividers.
- Feedback: combine status foreground, surface, and border tokens, for example `--fg-danger`, `--danger-surface`, and `--danger-border`. Status must remain understandable without color alone.
- Interaction: `--hover` and `--active` represent temporary feedback; `--selection` represents persistent selection.
- Typography and spacing: use `text-label`, `text-body`, `text-title`, and `text-heading`, the existing Tailwind spacing scale, and each component's supported size API.
- Elevation: use purpose-based `shadow-control`, `shadow-raised`, `shadow-floating`, and `shadow-overlay` with the appropriate surface.
- Motion: use `duration-fast`, `duration-moderate`, or `duration-slow` with a transition property, and the corresponding `*-exit` tier for shorter exits. Preserve component-owned springs and respect reduced motion.

## Foundations

- [Surfaces](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/surfaces): Five semantic surfaces with purpose-based shadows for light and dark mode.
- [Semantic Tokens](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/semantic-tokens): The complete runtime contract for color, surface, type, shape, and layering.
- [Scrollbars](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/scrollbars): A scrollbar that stays out of the way but never disappears, over shadcn's scroll-fade baseline — restyled to the shape system, native scroll on touch.
- [Motion](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/motion): Spring tokens, faster exits, and reflow-free weight animation — the motion rules shared by every component.

## Layouts and containers

- [AppShell](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/app-shell): Composable application frame for Sidebar, header, and main content.
- [AuthLayout](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/auth-layout): Full-height centered composition for authentication flows, with responsive widths and optional header and footer regions.
- [PageLayout](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/page-layout): Responsive composition for optional page information, route navigation, content, and asides.
- [Card](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/card): shadcn's compositional card, dressed in Zeron Design — stacked, inline, and grid layouts, borderless dividers, and 2-D proximity hover.
- [Container](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/container): Composable raised container with an optional header and footer around a floating content body.
- [Resizable](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/resizable): Accessible split-pane layouts with pointer and keyboard resizing, semantic constraints, and optional visual grips.
- [Separator](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/separator): Accessible horizontal and vertical rules with a semantic border color and layout-safe gutter.

## Navigation

- [Accordion](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/accordion): Collapsible sections with animated expand/collapse and proximity hover in grouped mode.
- [Sidebar](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/sidebar): Responsive navigation rail with desktop collapse and a mobile drawer.
- [TopNav](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/top-nav): Composable top navigation with brand, primary links, and actions.
- [Breadcrumb](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/breadcrumb): Composable path navigation with separators, current-page state, and collapsed levels.
- [NavMenu](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/nav-menu): Router-agnostic navigation primitives shared by Sidebar and TopNav.
- [Stepper](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/stepper): Accessible multi-step navigation with validation, completion states, and keyboard controls.
- [Tabs](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/tabs): Pill, segment, and underline tabs with a sliding active indicator.

## Forms and input

- [Checkbox](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/checkbox): Compact checkbox with checked, mixed, disabled, validation, and form states.
- [CheckboxGroup](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/checkbox-group): Checkbox group with merged backgrounds for contiguous selections.
- [ColorPicker](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/color-picker): Color picker with HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH formats, alpha, swatches, and popover trigger.
- [Combobox](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/combobox): Filterable single- or multi-select with typed object values, groups, chips, and custom triggers.
- [Field](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/field): Accessible form composition for labels, descriptions, validation messages, groups, and fieldsets.
- [Input](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/input): Text input with three variants, five sizes, and accessible validation states.
- [InputGroup](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/input-group): Composable input with addons, compact actions, textarea support, and validation.
- [RadioGroup](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/radio-group): Composable radio controls with form support and enhanced proximity-hover rows.
- [Select](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/select): Animated select menu with bordered/borderless variants and optional icons.
- [Slider](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/slider): Range slider with step snapping, range mode, and animated thumb.
- [Switch](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/switch): Toggle switch with animated thumb and label.
- [Temporal Picker](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/temporal-picker): Date, time, and date-time controls with explicit commitment, relative presets, availability rules, and IANA time-zone handling.
- [Textarea](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/textarea): Multi-line text input with semantic variants, two content sizes, resizing, and field validation support.

## Actions

- [Button](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/button): Versatile button with variants, sizes, loading state, and icon support.
- [ButtonGroup](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/button-group): Connected horizontal and vertical action groups with split-button, separator, and contextual-addon composition.
- [InputCopy](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/input-copy): Read-only input with copy-to-clipboard button and animated feedback.
- [Kbd](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/kbd): Compact keycaps and shortcut groups for keyboard commands and interaction hints.
- [SortableCollection](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/sortable-collection): Controlled reorderable list with optional inline editing, removal, and catalog-based adding.

## Data display and filtering

- [Avatar](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/avatar): Circle and rounded image or fallback primitives for people, agents, and accounts, with status, group, and compact user-detail composition.
- [Badge](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/badge): Compact label with categorical colors, custom recipes, semantic statuses, and soft, strong, or dot variants.
- [BadgeOverflow](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/badge-overflow): Responsive badge list that collapses hidden items into an overflow count.
- [DataGrid](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/data-grid): Virtualized spreadsheet grid with inline editing, range selection, search, copy and paste, and pinned columns.
- [DataTable](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/data-table): TanStack data table with sorting, filters, pagination, selection, visibility, and pinning.
- [FilterBuilder](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/filter-builder): Composable typed filters for complex data views, with text, number, option, boolean, date, async, and custom editors.
- [FilterQueryInput](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/filter-query-input): Structured cmdk query input with configurable fields, aliases, codecs, and portable filter clauses.
- [DetailList](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/detail-list): Framed label-value list with grouped sections and separators for compact resource and entity details.
- [MetricCard](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/metric-card): Self-sizing single-metric card with optional breakdown, trend visualization, data states, and whole-card interaction.
- [StatusOverview](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/status-overview): Inspectable timeline and node-status rail with semantic states, a shared tooltip, and keyboard navigation.
- [InfoItem](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/info-item): Composable information row with leading media, primary and supporting text, and a flexible trailing value or detail.
- [Table](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/table): Data table with row hover effects and semantic markup.
- [TimeRangeHistogram](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/time-range-histogram): Stacked time-bucket histogram with controlled pointer and keyboard range selection.
- [Tree](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/tree): Accessible hierarchical display and selection for general nodes, members, and files.

## Feedback and status

- [Alert](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/alert): Composable in-context callout with semantic statuses, optional icon, supporting detail, and action.
- [InlineNotice](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/inline-notice): Quiet inline emphasis that composes with Badge, with an optional semantic emphasized variant.
- [Empty](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/empty): Composable empty and first-use states for pages, sections, and inline data surfaces, with custom media and theme-aware illustrations.
- [Skeleton](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/skeleton): Token-native loading placeholder that composes into avatar, card, text, form, and table layouts.
- [Toast](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/toast): Animated notification stack with statuses, automatic dismissal, actions, and drag gestures.

## Overlays

- [Dialog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/dialog): Modal dialog with smooth enter/exit animations and overlay.
- [Dropdown](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/dropdown): Menu-style dropdown with proximity hover and animated backgrounds.
- [Popover](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/popover): Collision-aware floating content with a liquid anchor-to-panel transition.
- [Tooltip](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/tooltip): Floating tooltip with spring-based animations and configurable placement.

## AI and chat

- [AskUserQuestions](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/ask-user-questions): Stepped question flow with single/multi-select, optional 'other' input, and skip.
- [ChatMessage](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/chat-message): Chat transcript bubble with baked-in motion, user/assistant alignment, and file attachments.
- [InputMessage](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/input-message): Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea and configurable action slots.
- [ThinkingIndicator](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/thinking-indicator): Animated status indicator with morphing SVG and cycling text.
- [ThinkingSteps](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/components/thinking-steps): Chain-of-thought display with sequential animation and collapsible steps.

Check whether an item is a configurable data block or an editable application template. Connect product data and callbacks through its public API; replace demo data and actions when adapting a template.

- [Resource List Table 1](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/blocks/resource-list-table-01): A searchable, selectable resource inventory with status filtering and reusable row actions.
- [成员与部门](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/blocks/member-department-01): A member directory and expandable department workspace with search, account-status filtering, and responsive organization details.
- [File Manager 1](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/en/docs/blocks/file-manager-01): A token-native file-management workspace with icon, list, and Finder-style column views.

## Component selection and API guidance

Choose Table for mostly static tabular content, DataTable for records with sorting/filtering/pagination, and DataGrid for spreadsheet-style editing. Choose Select for a finite set of values and Combobox for searchable selection. Use Dropdown for commands and Dialog for a focused interrupting task.

For a resource list, start with PageLayout and DataTable plus the required toolbar, filters, and pagination. Reuse the host shell and give each region a clear scroll owner. Choose a matching block when its user task, structure, and integration API fit.

Component pages above contain usage and API references where available. Read exact prop types and callback signatures before writing code; do not assume Zeron props match similarly named shadcn or Base UI components. The Markdown guides below add intent, state, composition, and customization rules:

- [Button guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/components/button.md): Variant priority; size, loading, disabled, iconOnly, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, and asChild usage.
- [Avatar guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/components/avatar.md): Identity images, fallbacks, status, and group composition.
- [Input guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/components/input.md): Variants, control sizes, validation, and form integration.
- [Select guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/components/select.md): Value selection, sizes, icons, states, and composition.
- [Tree guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/components/tree.md): Hierarchy, selection, expansion, and tree interaction contracts.
- [Resource List Page guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/blocks/resource-list-page-01.md): Page composition, navigation, filters, and table integration.
- [Infinite Log Table guide](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/agent-guides/blocks/infinite-log-table-01.md): Schema-driven columns, filters, cursor pagination, and live data.

Use documented props and slots for customization. Preserve semantic colors, focus, disabled/loading behavior, and surface relationships. If a guide and installed implementation differ, use the installed types and source as the API authority.
